name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw
steps: Stand sideways a few steps from a solid wall in an athletic stance holding a medicine ball near your back hip.
Load your rear hip briefly by rotating your torso away from the wall with knees soft.
Pivot forcefully on your back foot, whip your hips and trunk toward the wall, and launch the ball explosively against it.
Catch the rebound smoothly to reload your rear hip, and switch sides after finishing one side.
tips: Initiate every throw from your rear hip and foot pivot before your arms release the ball.
Brace your core firmly through the release rather than twisting passively through your lower back.
